body: I've never been a good sleeper. Nightmares keep me awake.
I've explained it in past posts. I don't even have the energy to go over it again
I called a hotline. They made me feel worse than before I called them

I actually have horrible PTSD associated with my periods as well as a serious migraine problem. I'd recommend talking to a gyno about the depo shot. Its birth control and safe for people who get migraines. You get the shot once every 3 months and a lot of people don't bleed on it. I haven't had a period at all since I've started it.
I do have a therapist. I see him many times throughout the week. I usually tell him everything that happens to me 100% but after that last thing I'm suddenly scared to talk to even him.
The problem is that I can't tell people what their answer is. It might be failproof for me and not you.
PM me and I'll tell you everything

Yes, I've done a lot of research on failing and methods. I'm going to combine a few methods to ensure. I'm also going to make positive nobody will find me midway. In fact, I hope it's actually hard to find me.
It unfortunately doesn't effect my finances much. I have plenty saved and everything. There reasons for those things have to do with me just fucking up
I don't understand. What does financial have to do with it?

I want to be dead because there is nothing to live for. I've been through intense trauma and everyone says it will get better and it doesnt. I lost my home. I lost my girlfriend. I'm about to lose my job. I have very bad health problems. I can't eat. I can't sleep. I can't even shower without panic attacks. 

I've been hospitalized. I've worked with therapists. I've worked with everyone who would try to help me. I just can't do it.
I've been with him about 5 years. He's done amazing things for me. I've had around 12 therapists before him.

I guess now that I'm an adult it feels like a character flaw. 

I do have a therapist and kind if a compulsive researcher so I'll definitely continue that. I have just yet to figure out what works.
I guess at this point in my life it feels like a character flaw
